name: Lina's Sunbird
rangeDescription: Southern philippines (montane forest of eastern mindanao)
description: A small, localized bird of montane forest in eastern Mindanao. Has a long, curved bill, an olive back, an orange mark in the middle of the chest and a bluish tail with white tips.

name: Pygmy Antwren
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia to the guianas, amazonian brazil, and northern bolivia
description: Tiny, very short-tailed antwren of rainforest midstory and lower canopy. Males are yellow with white head and wing bars, and extensive black streaking on the head and back; females are similar to males, but have a red-orange wash on the head and more extensive streaking in the breast.

name: Calabarzon Babbler
rangeDescription: Philippines (southern sierra madre mountains of southern luzon)
description: A fairly small bird of lowland and foothill forest and edge; endemic to Luzon, though lumped with Visayan Babbler under “Black-crowned Babbler” by some taxonomies. Has a gray back and cheek with fine pale streaks, dark wings and tail with white outer tail feathers, white underparts, a pale rufous throat, and a black crown.

name: Waigeo Brushturkey
rangeDescription: Waigeo (raja ampat islands, off western new guinea)
description: A very little-known, large, black ground bird endemic to the upland forests on Waigeo Island. Black above with some chestnut in the breast and a bare pink head and throat.

name: Chatham Islands Parakeet
rangeDescription: Chatham islands (mangere and little mangare)
description: Medium-sized bright green parakeet mainly restricted to Mangere and Little Mangere Islands on the Chatham Islands of New Zealand. Note distinctive yellow crown above a red forehead.

name: Pink-browed Rosefinch
rangeDescription: Himalayan fir and birch forest from kashmir to southern tibet
description: Graceful medium-sized rosefinch of the Himalayas. Male is bright raspberry pink with a clean “browed” facial pattern and faint streaking on the back.

name: Red-billed Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Foothills of eastern ecuador and eastern peru (southward to madre de dios)
description: Small and rather scarce flycatcher found in disturbed forest on the east slope of the Andes. Yellowish-olive with a gray head and pale throat.

name: Kagu
rangeDescription: New caledonia
description: This unique and charismatic large flightless bird is the flagship species of New Caledonia. Now sadly limited to a handful of locations with high-quality forest.

name: Crested Bunting
rangeDescription: Northern pakistan to southeastern tibet, southern china, laos, and northern vietnam (tonkin)
description: Spiky upright crest distinguishes this large bunting from similar species. Male is glossy black with bright chestnut wings.

name: Great Hornbill
rangeDescription: Lowlands of india to southwestern china, southeastern asia, and sumatra
description: A huge, distinctive hornbill with a large yellow bill and casque. Black face, wings, and breast contrast with white neck, belly, and tail.

name: Puerto Rican Vireo
rangeDescription: Confined mainly to limestone hills of western and central puerto rico
description: A small, noisy inhabitant of woodlands including mangrove swamps and shade coffee plantations; often feeds low, near ground. This relatively plain species has a grayish head and chest that contrasts with a yellow-washed belly.

name: Carunculated Fruit-Dove
rangeDescription: Obi (north-central moluccas)
description: A unique small, colorful fruit-dove confined to Obi island. Pale gray head contrasts with mostly emerald-green body, except for gray markings on the wings and back, a deep maroon belly patch, and a lemon-yellow vent and undertail.

name: Maroon Pigeon
rangeDescription: Forest of são tomé (gulf of guinea)
description: A large, very dark pigeon with a grayish head, a burgundy body with scattered small white spots, and a bright yellow bill and legs. Female is duller than the male.

name: Gray Pratincole
rangeDescription: Rivers of mali to cameroon, western democratic republic of the congo, and northwestern angola
description: A compact, elegant pratincole, mostly pale gray above with a warm buffy nape that sometimes extends to the breast and a striking black-and-white face pattern; the legs and base of the bill are reddish. In flight, the striking black-and-white patterning in the wings and tail is unique.

name: Biak Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Numfor and biak (cenderawasih bay, off northwestern new guinea)
description: A fairly small bird of wooded areas on the Bay Islands. Low crest is flattened at the front and rounded at the back.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Taiwan Yuhina
rangeDescription: Montane forest of taiwan
description: A small, tit-like endemic songbird, brown above, white below, with a very distinctive head pattern: the pointed crest is white with a black-bordered chestnut front, and the ear coverts are outlined in black on the white face. Inhabits hilly and montane forests, where it roams about in large chattering flocks at all levels of the forest.

name: Short-legged Ground-Roller
rangeDescription: Dense rainforest of central and northeastern madagascar
description: Chunky, elaborately patterned, remarkably short-legged bird. White tail corners are conspicuous in flight.

name: Hudsonian Godwit
rangeDescription: Breeds locally in alaska and northern canada (east to hudson bay); winters in southern south america (argentina and south-central chile), southward to tierra del fuego
description: The smallest godwit, overall rather dark. Long upturned bill, red at the base with a black tip.

name: Tawny-browed Owl
rangeDescription: Eastern paraguay to southeastern brazil and northeastern argentina (misiones)
description: Large brown owl with dark eyes and distinctive white semicircles on its face. Streaked below with distinctive pale white bars.

name: Gray-striped Spurfowl
rangeDescription: Locally in escarpment of western angola
description: Large and brownish francolin that is endemic to Angola. Mostly buffy brown, with pale stripes on the back and chestnut stripes on the underparts.
